title: What if the biggest thing stopping you from finding your purpose... is believing purpose is all about YOU?
paragraphs: What if the biggest thing stopping you from finding your purpose... is believing purpose is all about YOU?
Read that again.
Many people spend their lives chasing success.
More money.
More recognition.
More followers.
More opportunities.
Yet they still feel empty.
Why?
Because purpose is not something you create.
Purpose is something you discover from the God who created you.
And that's exactly why I wrote:
📖 HOW TO LIVE A PURPOSE-DRIVEN LIFE
This is not another motivational book.
This is a biblical wake-up call for believers who are tired of drifting, distracted living and want to walk in the calling God designed for them.
If you've ever wondered:
❓ Why am I here?
❓ What does God want me to do?
❓ How do I know God's will for my life?
❓ Why do I feel stuck despite praying for direction?
This book was written for you.
🔥 INSIDE THIS POWERFUL GUIDE YOU'LL DISCOVER:
✅ How to identify God's purpose for your life
✅ The hidden enemies that keep believers from their calling
✅ How to overcome fear, doubt, distraction, and spiritual stagnation
✅ Biblical principles for making wise decisions
✅ How to develop daily discipline and consistency
✅ How to stop wandering and start walking with intentionality
✅ How to leave a legacy that honors Christ
✅ The difference between worldly success and Kingdom purpose
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE VS FEW PEOPLE
Most people want God to bless their plans.
Few people surrender to God's plan.
Most people seek comfort.
Few people pursue calling.
Most people ask God to change their circumstances.
Few people allow God to change them.
Most people live for today.
Few people live for eternity.
The question is:
Which group do you belong to?
